shots.action: The dancer flickers, then turns into a translucent glowing blue hologram, scan lines rolling down her body and the stage lights showing through her, glitching once before the projection steadies.
shots.sound: Sharp digital glitch bursts and a steady electronic hum.

end.paint: Turn the dancer into a translucent glowing blue hologram with fine horizontal scan lines; the red and blue stage light and haze show through her body. Keep the same pose, framing and background.
